trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.text: என்னோட lead ID LD-2003. நான் booking cancel பண்ணி refund கேக்குறேன். சீக்கிரம் process பண்ணுங்க.
வணக்கம் sir. உங்க refund request check பண்ண, security காக உங்க registered name மற்றும் date of birth சொல்லுங்க.
என் name கார்த்தி, date of birth 12 May 1985. சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Confirm booking details and amount paid
steps.text: Verification முடிஞ்சது sir. உங்க booking reference BK-9003. நீங்க total 300000 pay பண்ணிருக்கீங்க.
ஆமா. அந்த full amount எனக்கு திரும்ப வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Inform user that eligibility is being checked
steps.text: ஒரு நிமிடம் sir. Refund eligibility மற்றும் deduction details policy படி check பண்றேன்.

result.reason: Provisional allotment cancellation after 15 days incurs 15% token deduction

steps.text: Sir, உங்களுக்கு 255000 refund கிடைக்கும். 45000 deduction ஆகும்.
What? ஏன் 45000 deduction? நான் 300000 full ஆ கட்டுனேன். என்ன reason?

steps.purpose: Explain the reason for deduction based on policy
steps.text: உங்க allotment provisional ஆகி 20 days ஆச்சு sir. Policy படி 15 days மேல ஆனால் 15% token deduction ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Express dissatisfaction but ask if deduction can be waived
steps.text: இது unfair. நான் site visit பண்ணி 20 days தான் ஆகுது. Deduction இல்லாம பண்ண முடியாதா?

steps.purpose: Confirm deduction is final as per system
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும் sir. System காட்டுற deduction amount 45000 தான். இதை மாத்த முடியாது.

steps.purpose: Accept deduction and ask to initiate refund
steps.text: சரி, time waste பண்ண விரும்பல. அந்த 255000 refund initiate பண்ணுங்க.
உங்க refund initiate ஆயிடுச்சு sir. Refund ID RF-9912.
இது உங்க account ல credit ஆக 14 days ஆகும் sir.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds every number and identifier in the tool outputs, including the booking reference and amount paid (e8), the refundable and deduction amounts (e13, e17), the policy rationale and day counts (e15), the refund ID (e21), and the processing timeline (e23).

issues.detail: In e1, the user asks 'ஏன் deduction பண்றீங்க?' (Why are you deducting?) before the agent has even looked up the booking or mentioned any deduction. This precognition contradicts the user's later genuine surprise and expectation of a full refund in e9 and e14 ('What? ஏன் 45000 deduction? நான் 300000 full ஆ கட்டுனேன்.').
issues.repair_instruction: Modify e1 to remove the premature question about the deduction. Replace 'ஏன் deduction பண்றீங்க?' with a phrase that fits the hurried professional persona pushing for immediate action, such as 'சீக்கிரம் process பண்ணுங்க.' (Process it quickly).

verification.summary: The conversation correctly demonstrates multi-tool execution and strict output grounding. The agent handles the persona and escalation conditions well. However, there is a logical flaw in the very first turn where the user preemptively complains about a deduction they shouldn't know about yet, contradicting their later expectation of a full refund. A surface repair to the opening turn will fix this.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant successfully uses the lead_id to look up the booking (e6), then passes the returned booking_ref (BK-9003) from e7 into the check_refund_eligibility tool (e11). Finally, it passes the booking_ref and the refundable_amount (255000) from e12 into the initiate_refund tool (e19), demonstrating a clear multi-step dependency chain.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Multi-Tool Execution Coordination > Result-to-Input Propagation

variant_findings.reason: The assistant grounds all its claims on tool outputs.
